name: Pixeltable MCP
description: Model Context Protocol servers for Pixeltable: read-only web tools, developer tooling, and multimodal memory.

servers.name: pixeltable-web
servers.description: Read-only WebMCP transport with documentation search and integration listing.
servers.instructions: Read-only Pixeltable web tools. Use search_docs to find documentation URLs for a topic, and list_integrations to enumerate supported AI providers and tools. For code generation, fetch the returned documentation URLs or install the Pixeltable Skill (npx skills add pixeltable/pixeltable-skill). This server does not mutate any state.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search Pixeltable documentation by topic and return relevant documentation URLs.

tools.name: list_integrations
tools.description: List the AI providers and tools that integrate with Pixeltable.

servers.usage: POST JSON-RPC 2.0 messages (initialize, tools/list, tools/call) to https://pixeltable.com/mcp.

servers.name: pixeltable-developer
servers.description: MCP server exposing Pixeltable developer tooling: table inspection, queries, REPL, and documentation.

servers.name: pixeltable-memory
servers.description: MCP server providing multimodal memory backed by Pixeltable tables.
